changelog: v0: one model for every question type, reasoning on, one question per call

config.knob_notes: Roles are question types. models/thinking/max_tokens_by_type are keyed by question type; batch_size = questions of one type answered in one JSON call (1..12): fewer calls and less repeated prompt, but one bad reply loses the whole batch. A type's failures are wrong:<type>, bad_json:<type>, truncated:<type> (hit max_tokens), slow:<type> (mean call latency > 20 s).
